mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book(isbn, book_name, price, contact, condition_level, status, seller_id, create_time) VALUES (#{isbn}, #{bookName}, #{price}, #{contact}, #{conditionLevel}, #{status}, #{sellerId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, isbn, book_name AS bookName, price, contact, condition_level AS conditionLevel, status, seller_id AS sellerId, create_time AS createTime FROM book WHERE status = '上架在售' ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, isbn, book_name AS bookName, price, contact, condition_level AS conditionLevel, status, seller_id AS sellerId, create_time AS createTime FROM book WHERE book_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND status = '上架在售' ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, isbn, book_name AS bookName, price, contact, condition_level AS conditionLevel, status, seller_id AS sellerId, create_time AS createTime FROM book WHERE isbn = #{isbn} AND status = '上架在售'

SELECT id, isbn, book_name AS bookName, price, contact, condition_level AS conditionLevel, status, seller_id AS sellerId, create_time AS createTime FROM book WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, isbn, book_name AS bookName, price, contact, condition_level AS conditionLevel, status, seller_id AS sellerId, create_time AS createTime FROM book WHERE id = #{id}
